title: Implicit Design Choices and Their Impact on Emotion Recognition Model Development and Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Training an auxiliary 'attacker' network to predict gender from the target model's generated embeddings (measuring demographic leakage) and computing a Human-Centered Metric (HCM) that evaluates the intersection between the model's feature saliency weights and gender-associated sociolinguistic wordlists.

Computing a sensitive information reduction metric (HCMsirRace) by measuring the intersection and reliance of the model's feature saliency weights on race-associated sociological wordlists derived from the Implicit Association Test.

Computing a sensitive information reduction metric (HCMsirAge) by measuring the intersection of the model's feature saliency weights with age-associated sociolinguistic wordlists (e.g., vocabulary grade levels and word trends).
